authorization.request: Generate the entire current catalog in full Definition/v2 and authority/definitions/<definition-id>/<version>/ within each owning workspace
authorization.scope: Candidate generation, faithful representation conversion and maintenance placement; no fabricated semantic owner decisions Folder names and human indexes use definition names; stable IDs remain inside records.
authorization.naming_correction: Use readable names such as craft-method, person and definition-pack in directories and indexes; preserve stable IDs inside records.

contracts: Account for all 188 current identities exactly once; preserve all 194 admitted original bodies.
Every target satisfies the exact admitted Definition/v2 schema and original renderer.
Preserve scientific/formal, plain-language and domain-context voices, scope, boundaries, semantic owner, consumers and non-lineage semantic content exactly.
183 v1 bodies become fresh explicit representation successors; five existing v2 bodies retain their identity, version and exact original bytes.
Every materialized leaf binds an exact original field or explicitly attributed representation metadata; no circular self-lineage.
Definition home is <owning-workspace>/authority/definitions/<readable-definition-name>/<exact-version>/ with definition.json, generated DEFINITION.md and referenced evidence.
Placement is shared Lab orchestration, not a responsibility added to Define. No runtime copies, implicit projects or new owner grants.
Refuse duplicate destinations, unsafe names, changed original bytes, partial catalogs, schema omissions and conflicting placement.
Preserve actual outcomes: technical generation does not authorize canonical registry successor publication; source drift cannot be waived.
